selection: Four liquid stock/ETF instruments chosen before looking at outcomes; no parameter search.
windows: First 240 bars warmup; first 70% development; last 30% later screening, independently reset balances. Later window repeated with 1.5x all fees/spread/slippage.
data: Yahoo public regular-session split-adjusted bars; no invented missing candles; cash dividends excluded.
caveat: A positive later screen is not an untouched validation set after selecting among these twelve tests. Require a separate forward paper trial and longer intraday history before trading.
pre_execution_bug: Default structure strategy levels returned equal first/final targets with 50% partial exit, but the engine rejected equal targets. Fix will preserve a single full exit at the existing 2R target, rather than changing the entry rules or target distance.
